comment: Single source for Stage 3's pinned parameters (ruling sec.4, claude-reply-d593faf). Stage 3 is the PAIRED fleet read: calibrated teacher vs raw v10, same seed + same seat per pair; Gravy mirror vs heuristic; instrument 87/62. teacher_tuple is byte-identical reuse of the Stage 2 tuple (H8k-180+H): the games runner builds TEACHER_TUPLE_JSON from it and the PREGATE-GATE block compares it against the Stage 2 pre-gate manifest (no new pre-gate run). label_tuple is Stage 2's L3 tuple, unchanged. Life score (ONE definition: stage3_games_report.life_score, imported by the games analyzer): win -> 1; capped (winner 0) AND own life strictly greater than opponent's -> 1; else 0, computed from the driver rows' p1life/p2life in the arm's seat frame. The draw flag plays no part (the driver marks every capped game draw: true).

timeout_derivation.rule: timeout = 1.50 x Stage 2 observed max game wall = 1.5 x 2143 = 3214.5 -> 3214 s (the ruling's kept value); the product-of-maxima derivation is RETIRED

bands.inconclusive: teacher timeouts > 2% of teacher games (final counts), OR (excluded + dropped) pairs > 2% of attempted pairs (final counts; claude-reply-c924b19 sec.2.2)
bands.impeachment: primary mean diff > +0.25: impeachment checks print before the read

l3.seed_family_clearance: RANGE-DISJOINT (restated, claude-reply-c924b19 sec.2.4; the earlier 'one hundred million above' claim was false - the offset was +100,000). Seed lattice (s2_label_main.php + search code): seedBase = MEAS_SEED + job x 100,003; worlds at seedBase + w x 31,337; at 120 jobs x 50 worlds a shard family spans [base, base + 119 x 100,003 + 49 x 31,337] = [base, base + 13,435,870] (~13.4M). Stage 3 base 50055001 + shard x 10^8: at every shard its span sits 35,664,130 (~35.7M) above the top of Stage 2's same-shard span (955001 + 13,435,870) and 37,464,130 (~37.5M) below the next shard's Stage 0/2 base - ~36M clear of every Stage 0 (855001) and Stage 2 (955001) span at every shard; the families are range-disjoint, not merely value-disjoint. Registry note: Stage 0 and Stage 2 interleave the same way (offset 100,000) and are value-disjoint by the same lattice - noted, no action.
